name: study
description: Academic study work by data: anti-AI writing checks, grammar check through LanguageTool, editable Word and PowerPoint on the institution's template, APA citations, concept maps, typeset PDFs and decks, free-image sourcing, multi-area workspaces.

languagetool_url.title: LanguageTool server
languagetool_url.description: URL of a LanguageTool server you keep running, such as http://localhost:8081, for grammar_check. Empty: the folder below is used instead.

languagetool_home.title: LanguageTool folder
languagetool_home.description: The unzipped LanguageTool folder (it holds languagetool-commandline.jar), used by grammar_check when no server is set; needs Java 17 or later on PATH. Empty: grammar_check answers that it is not available.

openalex_mailto.title: OpenAlex contact email
openalex_mailto.description: Email sent to OpenAlex as mailto= to identify you (its polite pool). Empty: anonymous.

openalex_key.title: OpenAlex API key
openalex_key.description: Free account key from openalex.org/settings/api; raises the rate limits. Empty: anonymous limits.

semantic_scholar_key.title: Semantic Scholar API key
semantic_scholar_key.description: Optional key from semanticscholar.org/product/api; raises the rate limits. Empty: the shared pool.
